inputTableId.description: Unique ID of the input table from which data will be read for AutoML analysis deployment.

outputTable.description: Name of the output table where the prediction results will be stored.

calendarFrequency.description: Defines the frequency at which the deployment job should run.

interval.description: Specifies the interval for the schedule based on calendarFrequency.

hour.description: Specifies the hour of the day (0-23) when the deployment job should be triggered.

hourInterval.description: Specifies the hour interval between executions when applicable.

minute.description: Specifies the minute within the hour (0-59) when the deployment job should be triggered.

weekDay.description: Specifies the day of the week when the deployment job should be triggered.

monthDay.description: Specifies a particular day of the month when the deployment job should be triggered.

items.description: Each value must be a valid column name.

outputColumns.description: List of column names that will be written to the output table as part of the prediction results.

predictionColumn.description: Name of the column for which predictions will be generated.

serverOption.description: Specifies the server memory configuration for executing the AutoML deployment job.

timezone.description: Timezone to be used for scheduling the deployment job.

importType.description: Specifies how prediction results should be imported into the output table.

items.description: Each value must be a valid column name.

matchingColumns.description: List of column names used to match existing records in the output table when importType is UPDATEADD.
